description.raw: '''Passive:''' '''Nocturne''' gains [[File:Movement speed icon.png|15px|link=Movement speed]] 90% '''bonus''' movement speed while facing nearby [[File:Flee icon.png|20px|link=Flee|An icon representing the keyword Flee]] [[:Flee|feared]] targets.
description.text: Passive: Nocturne gains  90% bonus movement speed while facing nearby feared targets.

description2.raw: '''Active:''' '''Nocturne''' torments the target, forming a [[File:Focused Resolve.png|20px|link=Tether|An icon representing the keyword Tether]] [[:Tether|tether]] between himself and the target for 2 seconds, during which the target takes magic damage every 0.5 seconds over the duration.
description2.text: Active: Nocturne torments the target, forming a tether between himself and the target for 2 seconds, during which the target takes magic damage every 0.5 seconds over the duration.

description3.raw: If the tether is not broken by the end of its duration, the target is [[File:Flee icon.png|20px|link=Flee|An icon representing the keyword Flee]] [[:Flee|feared]] for a duration while being [[File:Slow icon.png|20px|link=Slow|An icon representing the keyword Slow]] [[:Slow|slowed]] by 90%.
description3.text: If the tether is not broken by the end of its duration, the target is feared for a duration while being slowed by 90%.

notes.raw: * ''Unspeakable Horror'' deals [[File:Blaze.png|20px|link=Damage|An icon representing the keyword Persistent damage]] [[:Damage|persistent damage]], additionally tagged as [[File:Irelia Vanguard's Edge.png|20px|link=Damage|An icon representing the keyword Indirect damage]] [[:Damage|indirect damage]], and applies [[File:Blackfire Torch item.png|20px|link=Ability effects|An icon representing the keyword Ability effects]] [[:Ability effects|spell effects]]. * Feared enemies in a [[File:Range center.png|20px|link=Range|An icon representing the keyword Centered range]] 180° total angle within '''Nocturne's''' facing direction will trigger ''Unspeakable Horror's'' passive. * Casting ''Unspeakable Horror'' may grant '''Nocturne''' permanent [[File:Ghost.png|20px|link=Unit collision|An icon representing the keyword Ghosted]] [[:Unit collision|ghosting]] until he has [[death|died]].(bug) * [[File:Spell Shield.png|20px|link=Spell shield|An icon representing the keyword Spell shield]] [[:Spell shield|Spell shield]] will block the tether's application but not the damage and aftereffects of one already applied.
notes.text:
Unspeakable Horror deals persistent damage, additionally tagged as indirect damage, and applies spell effects.
Feared enemies in a 180° total angle within Nocturne's facing direction will trigger Unspeakable Horror's passive.
Casting Unspeakable Horror may grant Nocturne permanent ghosting until he has died.(bug)
Spell shield will block the tether's application but not the damage and aftereffects of one already applied.
